# Atlas Robotics - FY2026 annual operating review (internal, long form)
Prepared by the office of the CFO. Figures are unaudited. This review consolidates the four
quarterly operating reviews into a single annual record for the board.

## Q1 FY2026

### Revenue

Q1 revenue was **$34.2M**, of which services were $6.1M and hardware $28.1M. Recurring contracts continued to anchor the base.

### Costs

Cost of goods sold was $19.8M and operating expenses $11.9M, split across R&D headcount, facilities, and go-to-market. Gross profit was $14.4M.

### Headcount

We ended Q1 with 298 employees, from 271 at the start of the quarter. Attrition was 5.2%.

### Commentary

Leadership noted that the Q1 constraint was execution capacity, not demand; the pipeline remained ahead of delivery throughout.

### Risks

Customer concentration and facility leases remained the two watch items in Q1; neither materially changed from the prior quarter.

## Q2 FY2026

### Revenue

Q2 revenue was **$33.9M**, of which services were $6.9M and hardware $27.0M. Recurring contracts continued to anchor the base.

### Costs

Cost of goods sold was $20.4M and operating expenses $12.6M, split across R&D headcount, facilities, and go-to-market. Gross profit was $13.5M.

### Headcount

We ended Q2 with 287 employees, from 298 at the start of the quarter. Attrition was 4.8%.

### Commentary

Leadership noted that the Q2 constraint was execution capacity, not demand; the pipeline remained ahead of delivery throughout.

### Risks

Customer concentration and facility leases remained the two watch items in Q2; neither materially changed from the prior quarter.

## Q3 FY2026

### Revenue

Q3 revenue was **$41.6M**, of which services were $9.2M and hardware $32.4M. Recurring contracts continued to anchor the base.

### Costs

Cost of goods sold was $22.9M and operating expenses $14.2M, split across R&D headcount, facilities, and go-to-market. Gross profit was $18.7M.

### Headcount

We ended Q3 with 312 employees, from 287 at the start of the quarter. Attrition was 4.1%.

### Commentary

Leadership noted that the Q3 constraint was execution capacity, not demand; the pipeline remained ahead of delivery throughout.

### Risks

Customer concentration and facility leases remained the two watch items in Q3; neither materially changed from the prior quarter.

## Q4 FY2026

### Revenue

Q4 revenue was **$47.3M**, of which services were $11.3M and hardware $36.0M. Recurring contracts continued to anchor the base.

### Costs

Cost of goods sold was $25.1M and operating expenses $15.8M, split across R&D headcount, facilities, and go-to-market. Gross profit was $22.2M.

### Headcount

We ended Q4 with 340 employees, from 312 at the start of the quarter. Attrition was 3.9%.

### Commentary

Leadership noted that the Q4 constraint was execution capacity, not demand; the pipeline remained ahead of delivery throughout.

### Risks

Customer concentration and facility leases remained the two watch items in Q4; neither materially changed from the prior quarter.

## Full-year summary

FY2026 revenue totalled $157.0M against $131.4M in FY2025. The services mix rose across every quarter. Headcount grew from 271 to 340 while attrition fell from 5.2% to 3.9%. The board's standing concerns - the two-customer concentration and the Fremont lease renewal in 2027 - carry into FY2027.
